verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no built-in, in-product AI assistant that users can hand tasks to. The official MCP server (docs-13, docs-21) lets external AI tools like Cursor or Claude call GrowthBook. That is an integration for outside agents, not an assistant inside the product. The "AI Visual Editor" (docs-66, docs-77) appears only as a feature name with no description of delegating tasks, and the Cmd+K command palette is navigation, not AI. These are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.
